title: Run Tdarr Matrix Full Audit In Background
summary: Make the Tdarr Matrix 100 percent diagnostics action return a backend-owned background run handle instead of holding a long WebView request open.
reason: The full matrix proof can spend minutes preparing evidence and potentially days processing 4,632 generated inputs, so tying it to one HTTP request causes the diagnostics panel to look failed while backend work continues.
behavior_before: The 100 percent Tdarr Matrix action launched the full audit synchronously through the diagnostics command route. The browser had to wait for the entire 4,632-file run to finish before receiving a command result.
behavior_after: The 100 percent Tdarr Matrix action preassigns a run ID, launches the same allowlisted audit command in the background, and returns the run root/report path for polling through the diagnostics console.
tests_added: tests/python/desktop/test_service_tdarr_matrix_audit.py verifies the full preset can pass a backend-owned --run-id
tests/python/desktop/test_service_tdarr_matrix_audit.py verifies the full service path starts a background subprocess instead of run_capture
tests/python/desktop/test_service_tdarr_matrix_audit.py verifies background-start command results report active progress
tests/python/desktop/test_service_tdarr_matrix_audit.py verifies a requested run can be shown before its final report exists
rollback_plan: Remove the full-preset background launch handling and restore synchronous full audit execution; rerun Tdarr Matrix diagnostics service and WebView mutation-boundary tests.
notes: Started after observing a live --all-samples process and a 4,632-row run root that had not yet reached worker processing.
